verdict.rationale: A direct probe returned HTTP 200 for https://docs.warp.dev/openapi.json, and the file contains an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec can be downloaded. Warp also presents itself as an API platform whose cloud agents can be run via APIs. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or linking the spec and its coverage of the API surface, independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec is complete and usable (e.g., for client generation).
